slides.title: Behavioral Patterns Overview
slides.prompt: Behavioral patterns manage algorithms, relationships, and responsibilities between objects. Observer enables event notification, Strategy encapsulates interchangeable algorithms, Command wraps requests as objects, and State alters behavior when internal state changes.

slides.title: Observer Subject Registration
slides.prompt: Fill in the method name used by a Subject to register an Observer object.

slides.title: Strategy Pattern in Pythonic Style
slides.prompt: How is the Strategy pattern often implemented in Python without needing boilerplate class hierarchies?
options: By passing functions directly as first-class objects into context classes
By using metaclasses to dynamically swap methods
slides.correctAnswer: By passing functions directly as first-class objects into context classes

slides.title: Command Pattern Execution Interface
slides.prompt: Fill in the standard method name invoked on a Command object to trigger its encapsulated action.

slides.title: Observer Pattern Notification Trigger
slides.prompt: What happens when a Subject's state changes in an Observer pattern setup?
options: It loops over all attached observers and calls their update method
It rebuilds the entire application state tree
It serializes all registered observers to disk
It spawns a new process for each registered observer
slides.correctAnswer: It loops over all attached observers and calls their update method

slides.title: State Pattern Class Delegation
slides.prompt: Fill in the variable name that holds the current state object in a State pattern context.

slides.title: Command Pattern Core Benefit
slides.prompt: Which of the following operations is cleanly enabled by using the Command Pattern?
options: Undo/Redo history stacks and task queuing
Connecting C libraries to Python via FFI
slides.correctAnswer: Undo/Redo history stacks and task queuing
